h1: Get Your Free Painting Estimate – Professional Painters

items.q: What types of painting services do you offer?

a.text: We provide complete interior and exterior painting services for residential homes, HOA properties, and commercial buildings. Our team handles specialized projects including cabinet refinishing, millwork, drywall repair, and deck or fence staining.
a.html: We provide complete interior and exterior painting services for residential homes, HOA properties, and commercial buildings. Our team handles specialized projects including cabinet refinishing, millwork, drywall repair, and deck or fence staining.

items.q: How do I request and receive a free estimate?

a.text: You can submit your details directly through our online form or call us at 206-250-1194. Provide your contact info and project location, and our team will follow up—typically within one business day—to discuss your scope or schedule an on-site evaluation.
a.html: You can submit your details directly through our online form or call us at 206-250-1194. Provide your contact info and project location, and our team will follow up—typically within one business day—to discuss your scope or schedule an on-site evaluation.

items.q: What factors go into calculating my estimate?

a.text: Estimates are calculated based on overall square footage, surface preparation requirements, the condition of existing materials, paint selection, and job complexity—such as height access for exteriors or detailed millwork indoors.
a.html: Estimates are calculated based on overall square footage, surface preparation requirements, the condition of existing materials, paint selection, and job complexity—such as height access for exteriors or detailed millwork indoors.
